map.如何使用颠倒文字？: How do I use Upside-Down Text?
map.颠倒文字适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Upside-Down Text best for?
map.💡 颠倒文字使用 Unicode 字符替换并反转顺序。仅支持英文字母和部分符号，: 💡 Upside-down text uses Unicode characters to substitute and reverse the order. It only supports English letters and some symbols; Chinese/digits may not be supported.
map.趣味装饰：把文字上下翻转，做社媒特效或贺卡。: Fun decoration: flip text upside down for social-media effects or greeting cards.
map.隐藏提示：用翻转呈现彩蛋式文案。: Hidden hints: use flipping to reveal easter-egg style copy.
map.视觉测试：检查字体对翻转字符的覆盖。: Visual testing: check how well a font covers flipped characters.
map.输入「hello」，倒置输出「oʅʅǝɥ」（用翻转映射字符），复制后显示为上下颠: Input "hello"; the flipped output is "oʅʅǝɥ" (using flipped-mapping characters); after copying it displays upside down. Purely decorative, it carries no real semantic meaning.
map.为什么有些字翻转后不像？: Why do some characters not look flipped?
map.翻转字符映射表，覆盖拉丁字母较全，中文/符号无对应翻转形态会被跳过或原样，呈现不: the flipped-character mapping table, which covers Latin letters fairly completely; Chinese/symbols with no flipped form are skipped or left as-is, giving incomplete output.
map.能当密文用吗？: Can it be used as a cipher?
map.不能。只是字符映射，任何人都可再翻转还原，且无保密性，仅作展示趣味。: No. It is only character mapping; anyone can flip it back, and it has no secrecy — it is just for fun display.
